REVIEW T-F17 (updated — rework complete, supersedes prior note): branch task/T-F17-mission-control @ 903f00e.

Coordinator rework addressed in full:
1. REVERTED all host/ changes (app.cpp, app_state.h, scenarios, CMakeLists restored to master; host mission_control_panel deleted) — no fixes to the corpse remain.
2. PORTED panel to ui/imgui/src/ui/mission_control_panel.{h,cpp} on the T-U1 panel_scaffold kit (parts_panel/transparency_panel exemplars): run tree with status-colored glass rows, full event trail (Hide-thoughts toggle), steering section. View-model stays in ui/abstract/mission_control_view.h.
3. AI_CAD_SHOT=mission_control wired as a seeded one-shot in ui/imgui scenarios.{h,cpp}, appended after the T-U8 transparency block (no step machine, per issue #7). Fixture is capstone-shaped and ends PAUSED at the pre-order gate.
4. LIVE STEERING wired (not stubbed): new services/dag/worker_rpc.py exposes dag_status/dag_approve/dag_abort as worker methods (thin wrappers over executor.resume() — same single implementation as the MCP twins), registered append-only in engine_oracle/worker.py per the deliverables-seam precedent. Approve/Reject buttons call them via AsyncRpc; Refresh replays the EventJournal via dag_status's new events_jsonl field.
5. Verified: AI-CAD2 build green under flock; ui_style_check.py 0 findings; headless --shot PNG EYEBALLED at scratch/mission_control_shots/aicad2_mission_control.png — shows paused mission "Battery-Powered Soil-Moisture Sensor", node rows (design/gate/ecad/firmware/structural/source), colored event trail, Approve+Reject enabled at gate n_gate_preorder, honest "coming with T-BL09" deferral note. dag worker seam smoke-tested (3 methods, clean error envelopes); services/dag tests: all T-F17 tests pass; 3 dag_planner-prompt failures are pre-existing on the clean merged HEAD.

Honestly deferred (noted in panel + T-F17.md DoD): design-brief flow, mid-run inject, pause-mid-node, autonomy re-dial (need T-BL09 + executor seams); built-in agent loop does not emit the schema yet.

Task status: review. Ready for human merge.
